title: Book One · Chapter 109: Rain Along the Wall
story:
The warm rain begins before Ronan wakes.

It runs down the window and makes the yard look smaller. The pot by the wall is wet to the bottom. The plant had only three leaves when they moved in. Now it has new leaves too. Water hangs from every tip.

Mum moves the washing line indoors. Dad gets ready for work. First he checks the path. It leads from their door to the green gate. There is a shallow puddle by the wall, away from their door.

“Do not jump in it with your school shoes,” Mum says.

“I have not jumped.”

“You are eight, Ronan. I know you.”

Ronan looks down at his shoes. One toe is already pointing towards the puddle.

Mrs Lan calls from the front room. The bowl under her small roof drip is full. Dad needs to empty it. Dad takes it outside while she puts another bowl in place. A repair man will come to look at the roof. He needs to choose a safe time, she says.

“I can look,” Ronan offers.

“You can look from here,” Dad says. “The roof is adult work.”

He brings the bowl back. Then he wipes the wet patch on the floor. The tap in the yard does not drip. Dad's old repair is still working. The roof drips and rain make different water noises now.

At school, the covered passage is crowded with umbrellas. Children shake them too close to one another. Leo arrives with one wet shoulder. He walked too far from his mother under her umbrella.

“It rained sideways at me,” he says.

Mei holds her drawing book inside a cloth bag. The bag has a dark patch, but the book is dry. She checks the book. Then she hangs her coat.

The boat book stays on the shelf with its cover on. No one needs another river visit today. Miss Wu has them read a story about a market instead. There are lines about a closed shop. Ronan reads those more slowly than the rest.

After school, Mum is late by a few minutes. Mum told him, “Wait inside the gate.” He waits there. Leo's father offers to walk Ronan home. Miss Wu says they must let Mum know first. Then Mum appears under her broad umbrella. She is out of breath.

“A customer stayed to talk,” she says. “I am sorry you waited.”

“I stayed here.”

“I can see. Thank you.”

They take the usual road. A sheet covers the roof of Mr Qiu's stall. A corner flaps in the wind. Mr Qiu is pulling a box further inside.

“Will his books get wet?” Ronan asks.

“I hope not. We can ask when there is room.”

A cart is passing the narrow place. Mum keeps Ronan beside her. The cart passes. They stay back from the flapping sheet. No one asks Ronan to try to catch it.

At home, Ronan checks his own shelf. The wooden boat is dry. The bell has no water on it. His old map is safe beneath the red sail book.

He wants to move every object away from the window. Mum helps him check the window first. No water is coming through. They move only the papers near the glass.

For supper they have hot rice and greens. Mrs Lan knocks with a message for the repair man. Can Dad pass it to him tomorrow? “I can pass the message,” Dad says. “But the repair man chooses the visit time.”

Ronan listens to the rain while Mum clears the bowls. He has a dry place tonight. He thinks about Mrs Lan's bowl and Mr Qiu's sheet. People have to work to keep those places dry.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- shallow puddle＝浅水坑
- flaps＝拍打、飘动
- out of breath＝喘气
- pass the message＝传话

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：roof＝屋顶；tip＝叶尖；umbrella＝雨伞。

## 读句提示

**Mum told him, “Wait inside the gate.”**

妈妈告诉他：“在校门里面等。”随后He waits there中的there就指校门里。

## 理解问题

1. 雨天里哪些事由成人处理？
2. Ronan为什么只移动靠窗的纸，而没有搬空架子？
